recorded.outcome:q-levers: "no single start and no pair of starts can overflow a year (the room argument of lesson 6.7.2 needs a project that is large next to the row)".

gates.says: all 9 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-lp-point:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-lp-point:a: "The fractions come from the rows, not the costs: the objective only picks which allowed point is best".
recorded.prompt:q-lp-point:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-lp-point:c: The page says to look where variables "should be 0 or 1 and are not"; the starts were mostly whole, and the fractional fronts pointed at the front rows.
recorded.prompt:q-lp-point:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-lp-point:d: "only the rows decide which fractional points are allowed"; the remedy was a row change, not solver settings.
recorded.prompt:q-report:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-report:a: "Do not claim a speed-up." The reformulated model took 7,823 nodes against 3,856.
recorded.prompt:q-report:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-report:b: Both models allow exactly the same plans. The equal root bounds mean presolve and cuts "had recovered" the gap, not that the model is broken.
recorded.prompt:q-report:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-report:c: "The counts are not noise: HiGHS's node counts repeat from run to run on the same model".
recorded.prompt:q-levers:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-levers:a: The page gives the cause as data shape ("because its budgets are large next to its projects"). The same code found eight fixings on small, so presolve is not the reason.
recorded.prompt:q-levers:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-levers:b: "On GridCap small with hard crew rows... the same code found eight fixings and 70 new conflicts" from capacity rows, not only from same-project starts.
recorded.prompt:q-levers:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-levers:d: The model writes budget rows as ≤: "... ≤ B_y (budget_y)".
